description: Find e-eSIM eSIM plans for one destination or several (countries or regions, any language). Returns the best-value plans first with full facts, coverage lists and a direct link; multi-country plans that include the destination are returned too and marked covers_via. Use when a user wants mobile data abroad; use recommend_plan when they describe a whole trip.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. "en-gb", "de-de". Wins over language; prices and links are quoted in it.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code. Every price in the result is quoted in it.

destination.description: Country or region in any language, e.g. "Thailand", "Japon", "Europa", or a 2-letter ISO code. For a city, pass its country.

destinations.description: Several countries for one trip; only plans covering ALL of them are returned. Overrides destination.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Plan names and country names come back in it when available. Bare "en" is quoted in en-us / USD.

limit.description: Plans to return. Default 10; all_plans_url lists everything.

min_days.description: Only plans valid for at least this many days.

sort.description: value = best price per GB delivered / cheapest All You Can Surf per day first (default); price = cheapest first; data = most data first.

name: search_esim_plans

destinations.description: How each requested destination was understood.

from_price.description: Lowest price in this result set, shop-formatted (per-day plans count with their day price).

iso.description: Resolved ISO code or region slug of the (first) destination.

message.description: Present when nothing matched: says why and what to try.

note.description: Present when part of the request could not be honoured (e.g. more than 5 destinations).

items.description: One eSIM plan. Every field is present only when the catalogue holds a value for it; an absent field is unknown, never "no".

always_on_rate.description: Reduced speed after the allowance, e.g. "5 Mbps" / "128 kbps" (for the rest of that day on per_day plans; for the rest of the trip on Trip Surf). All You Can Surf stays unlimited in volume at this speed.

carrier.description: Local network operator when specified (1.0.x name; also in networks). NEVER invent one when absent.

coverage_countries.description: Every country the plan works in.

name.description: Country name in the requested language.

coverage_label.description: Human-readable coverage label as the shop shows it (localized).

coverage_note.description: Coverage caveat to present verbatim, e.g. traffic routed via Hong Kong.

covers_via.description: Present when the plan was returned for a country it covers as part of a multi-country plan: the plan's own region name.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of every price in this object.

daily_high_speed.description: Daily Surf / All You Can Surf: daily allowance at full speed, e.g. "2GB".

daily_reset_time.description: When the daily allowance refreshes (per_day plans only), e.g. "00:00 (UTC+8)" or "every 24 h after activation".

data.description: Trip Surf: total data label, e.g. "5GB".

data_gb.description: Data amount in GB. Meaning given by data_period.

data_period.description: "total": data_gb is the whole plan (Trip Surf). "per_day": data_gb is the daily full-speed allowance (Daily Surf, All You Can Surf).

expires_on.description: Hard supplier end date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which the plan stops working and unused data is lost, whatever validity the customer picks. Say it plainly when present.

fair_use.description: All You Can Surf fair-use policy in plain words (daily full-speed allowance, then the still-unlimited reduced speed). Present it as returned.

family_id.description: Plans sharing a family_id are day-length variants of the same package.

grade.description: All You Can Surf tier (standard, premium, titanium). Present only the returned value; every grade has a daily full-speed allowance then a reduced speed.

last_updated.description: Date the plan was last updated in the catalogue (YYYY-MM-DD).

name.description: Short plan name: destination · data · validity · type.

network_generation.description: Network generation, e.g. "5G/4G". Never an operator name.

networks.description: Operator name(s) for the plan, as the shop states them.

plan_note.description: Customer-facing caveat for this plan in plain words: a daily cut-off, a coverage exclusion, an activation or verification step. Present it as returned whenever present.

price.description: FULL fixed price of the plan in currency; not per day, not per GB. The price shown is the price paid.

price_is_final.description: Always true: no tax or fee is added at checkout.

pricing_bucket.description: language-region bucket the prices and links are quoted in, e.g. "en-us".

product_id.description: Product id. Use it for get_plan_details and start_checkout.

rating.description: Average customer rating (1-5). Present only when reviews exist.

review_count.description: Number of reviews. Present only when > 0.

summary.description: Short description in the requested language, from the product page.

throttle_kbps.description: The same reduced speed in kbps. 0 = no throttle stated for this plan.

title.description: Full product title in the requested language.

kind.description: Always "none" on e-eSIM: no top-ups or recharges exist; each plan is a self-contained eSIM.

type.description: Plan type. Brand names — keep in English.

url.description: Product page in pricing_bucket. Use verbatim.

validity_clock.description: What the days count means for THIS plan: 24-hour periods from activation, or calendar days ending at a fixed clock (e.g. "ends 23:59 (UTC+8)"). State it; a 1-day calendar plan activated in the evening lasts only hours.

voice_sms.description: Always "none": data only, no telephone number, no SMS.

total_available.description: Plans matched before limit; the rest are on all_plans_url.

title: Find eSIM plans
